about: fk-form's application mutants; each is judged by the example's tests, laws and cases (scripts/examples), not by a compiler test.

mutants.name: fk5-name-edit-enters
mutants.rule: A name edit keeps the entry, so an email check under way goes on (law StaleCheckIsDropped; a fold cannot see it).

mutants.name: fk5-email-edit-stays
mutants.rule: An email edit opens a new entry, so the check of an older address ends and its answer is dropped (law StaleCheckIsDropped).

mutants.name: fk5-note-edit-clears-name
mutants.to: Stay[Form]{Next: Form{..f, Note: e.Text, Name: NameField("")}}
mutants.rule: An edit touches only its own field (law EditClearsThatFieldsError).

mutants.name: fk5-note-edit-resets-stage
mutants.to: Stay[Form]{Next: Form{..f, Note: e.Text, Stage: Editing}}
mutants.rule: An edit touches no other field and not the stage: a note edit after a sent or refused submit keeps the stage (law EditClearsThatFieldsError alone; no case edits the note after a submit).

mutants.name: fk5-edit-while-sending
mutants.rule: During a submit the form takes no edit (law EditClearsThatFieldsError).

mutants.name: fk5-submit-while-checking
mutants.from:
case Valid[Email]:
		true
	case Unchecked, Checking[Email], Invalid[EmailWhy]:
		false
	}
	name && email
mutants.to:
case Valid[Email], Checking[Email]:
		true
	case Unchecked, Invalid[EmailWhy]:
		false
	}
	name && email
mutants.rule: A submit waits for the email's check to answer (law SubmitOnlyWhenAllValid; the script always waits, so no case sees it).

mutants.name: fk5-submit-while-sending
mutants.rule: A submit while a submit is under way is ignored (law SubmitOnlyWhenAllValid).

mutants.name: fk5-taken-inverted
mutants.rule: An address on the list is Invalid with Taken; a new one is Valid (case subscribe).

mutants.name: fk5-no-join
mutants.rule: A Sending form's entry owns the submit: with no work, no answer ever comes (the cases' script waits for it).

mutants.name: fk5-refused-as-sent
mutants.rule: A refused subscription shows the refusal (case subscribe).

mutants.name: fk5-name-min-three
mutants.rule: A name of two bytes is valid (case invalid: name Ad).

mutants.name: fk5-name-required
mutants.rule: The name is optional: an empty name is Unchecked and the form may be sent (law SubmitOnlyWhenAllValid; case subscribe).

mutants.name: fkre-email-ascii-space
mutants.rule: An address's local part holds no space of JavaScript's \s, upstream's, not only the ASCII ones (law EmailIsThePattern; the cases have only the ASCII space).

mutants.name: fkre-domain-any-rune-for-dot
mutants.rule: The domain has a dot with text on both sides, not any rune there (law EmailIsThePattern).

mutants.name: fk5-memory-admin-case
mutants.rule: The list finds an address in any case of its letters (law Subscribers.TakenIgnoresCase; no case uses this address).
